summary.text: Stella Pollard is the Democratic candidate for Kentucky State Senate District 20 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Republican Gex Williams.
According to her campaign website, Pollard is a public school educator and the first in her family to graduate from college.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Stella Pollard describes herself as a daughter of rural Kentucky and the first in her family to graduate from college.
The site says she is a public school educator and has served as president of the Franklin County Democratic Women's Club and on its executive committee.

It lists support for local infrastructure funding and accountability, working families and public education among her priorities, and says she has been endorsed by the Kentucky UAW, the AFL-CIO (KY) and Iron Workers Local 44.
